title: Battle of Anderlecht
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Anderlecht", at revision 1370106779, opens: "The Battle of Anderlecht, sometimes referred to as the Fight of Anderlecht, took place in Anderlecht near Brussels, capital of the Austrian Netherlands. It was fought between the Habsburg monarchy and the French Republic on 13 November 1792, during the first year of the French Revolutionary Wars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2887849, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1792 battle of the War of the First Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
